import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
entry=pathlib.Path('docs/DevDocs/assets/20o-b2-a/entry-20261105')
load=lambda path:json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha=lambda value:hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
b=load(entry/'planning-review-baseline.json')
raw=subprocess.check_output(['cmd','/c','git','show',b['prepared_commit']+':'+b['reviewed_plan_file']])
assert sha(raw)==b['reviewed_plan_sha256'] and raw==(entry/b['plan_snapshot']).read_bytes()
after=pathlib.Path(b['reviewed_plan_file']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
transition=load(entry/'approval-transition.json')
assert sha(after)==transition['approved_status_plan_sha256'] and after==(entry/'plan-after-approval.txt').read_bytes()
old,new=raw.decode('utf-8'),after.decode('utf-8')
assert old.split('## 四、分批执行',1)[1].split('## 五、测试与证据矩阵',1)[0]==new.split('## 四、分批执行',1)[1].split('## 五、测试与证据矩阵',1)[0]
assert [l for l in old.splitlines() if l.startswith('| A-P')]==[l for l in new.splitlines() if l.startswith('| A-P')]
receipts=load(entry/'decision-receipts.json')['receipts']
assert len(receipts)==3
for i,r in enumerate(receipts):
    assert r['answer']=='批准' and not r['conditional'] and r['valid_for_planning_approval']
    assert json.loads(r['question_item_id'])==['request_user_input_async','call_942f8d5bfc6a4afc94c5a0df689dad9a',i]
    assert r['reviewed_plan_sha256']==b['reviewed_plan_sha256']
for source in load(entry/'signature-and-scope-audit.json')['signed_objects']:
    assert sha(pathlib.Path(source['file']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'))==source['sha256']
assert load(entry/'decision-requests.json')['requests']==[]
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'actual_approvals':3,'reviewed_plan_sha256':sha(raw),'current_status_plan_sha256':sha(after),'implementation_scope_unchanged':True,'f_d_objects_unchanged':True,'product_started':False}))
